accessibility.doc: UI accessibility settings (SPEC §6.11; docs/kb/art/ui.md §4.2, §5 and §9; docs/kb/tech/ui.md § Accessibility). UiSettings reads this file; the settings menu lists `settings` in order and shows each option through its loc key.

timing_assist.doc: M2-UI-01: what each timing_assist option does to a timed Swell input row (swell.json inputs, kind timing_ring) before the ring is built. window_scale multiplies perfect_sec and good_sec, then good_sec is clamped so the window stays inside its beat; assist_grade is the grade a miss becomes; tag_key is the short tag the input panel shows while the assist is on. Numbers: docs/kb/design/formulas.md section Swell, Timing assist.
